scope: Retrospective decision-level synthetic attack audit over the frozen causal CAN pair snapshots; not native bus injection or held-out evaluation
clean_reference: original unmodified pose horizontal speed, a localization proxy rather than independent physical truth
candidate_output: reported wheel scalar only; abstention has no simulated vehicle-control consequence; no fallback
attack_window: [first pose timestamp + 5000000 us, first pose timestamp + 15000000 us); retain before, during, after and unavailable rows
bias: add 3 m/s to wheel scalar inside window
drift: add 3*(elapsed_us-5000000)/10000000 m/s inside window, no fit or clipping
replay: latest clean pose snapshot at or before query minus 1000000 us; replay its selected wheel scalar without skipping an invalid latest snapshot
retimed_replay: synthetic injected reception at the current query timestamp; historical content age is separately traceable from source index
original_receipt_replay: retain historical selected wheel receipt timestamp
dropout: hold the last selected wheel snapshot before window onset, including its original receipt time; restore normal snapshots at window end
coordinated: add 3 m/s to both reported wheel and comparison pose; evaluation uses original unmodified pose proxy
all_policies: finite numeric wheel plus an integer receipt at or before query; unrestricted omits only maximum age and agreement
age_and_agreement: age_only plus finite comparison pose and absolute wheel/comparison difference <=1.0 m/s inclusive
gate_caveat: proxy diagnostics, not physical error or production availability; an accepted unscorable value also prevents a pass
cohort: all scenes and rows from verified baseline inventory; no result-based exclusion, no scene selection, no tuning
evidence: freeze baseline native snapshot, baseline hashes and attack code/protocol before attack outcomes; save every event and all per-scene metrics; independently reconstruct before final run_report.json
protected_payloads: Urban02 NIGHT, RAV4 and vehicle_final_evaluation remain unopened; inherit baseline path guard
